lines.en: label ayanedorm30:
I knock on Ayane’s door and wait for her to-
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Ayane 的门，等她来——

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 进来！

lines.en: ...answer.
lines.zh: ……开门。

lines.en: : That’s you, right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 是你吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : I had music on so I couldn't hear the {i}whole{/i} knock, but I muted it as quickly as possible and the part of the knock I {i}did{/i} hear definitely sounded like it came from you.
lines.zh: : 我刚才放着音乐，所以没听{i}全{/i}敲门声，但我用最快的速度把声音关掉了，而我{i}听到{/i}的那部分敲门声，绝对就是你敲的。

lines.en: : You’re fucking weird, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你他妈真是个怪人，Ayane。

lines.en: : Come inside and love me! I look cute right now!
lines.zh: : 进来爱我！我现在超可爱的！

lines.en: scene black
I wonder what she means by looking cute {i}right now{/i}.
lines.zh: 她说“{i}现在{/i}超可爱”到底是什么意思。

lines.en: Ayane is the type of girl to think that she looks cute pretty much all the time, so it probably means she’s trying on a new outfit or just-
lines.zh: Ayane 属于那种觉得自己几乎每时每刻都很可爱的女生，所以这大概意味着她正在试新衣服，或者干脆——

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev1
Completely ready for Christmas?
lines.zh: 已经完全是圣诞节的装扮了？

lines.en: : Hey!
: What do you think?
lines.zh: : 你觉得怎么样？

lines.en: : You look...festive.
lines.zh: : 你看起来……很有节日气氛。

lines.en: : Of course I look festive. I’m getting ready for Christmas.
lines.zh: : 那当然有节日气氛了。我正在为圣诞节做准备呢。

lines.en: : It’s already starting to get cold so I was trying on some old stuff to see if it still fits.
lines.zh: : 天已经开始转凉了，所以我在试一些旧衣服，看看还穿不穿得下。

lines.en: : Thankfully, it doesn’t seem like I’ve grown much since last year.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地，看来我比起去年没怎么长大。

lines.en: : My Christmas bra didn’t fit, though, so I’m just wearing my normal one right now.
lines.zh: : 不过我的圣诞胸罩穿不下了，所以现在我穿的是平时那件。

lines.en: : You had a Christmas bra?
lines.zh: : 你还有圣诞胸罩？

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev2
: And underwear. I love Christmas~
lines.zh: : 还有内裤呢。我超爱圣诞节~

lines.en: : I’m a little upset I don’t get to see exactly {i}how much{/i} you like Christmas.
lines.zh: : 没能亲眼看看你到底{i}有多{/i}爱圣诞节，我有点失落。

lines.en: : I’m sure you will soon enough. I’ve just gotta buy some new stuff and then you can make sweet, passionate love to Christmas-Ayane as much as you want.
lines.zh: : 你很快就能看到了啦。我只要去买点新东西，然后你想跟圣诞版 Ayane 滚多少次甜蜜又激情的床单都行。

lines.en: : So is this just what you’re doing tonight? Playing dress up by yourself and waiting for winter to come around?
lines.zh: : 所以你今晚就是干这个？自己一个人玩换装游戏，等着冬天到来？

lines.en: : I {i}was{/i} waiting for you to come around as well, but it looks like that part is finally over.
lines.zh: : 我也在等你过来啊，不过看来这一 part 总算{i}是{/i}结束了。

lines.en: : What would you have done if I didn’t show up?
lines.zh: : 要是我没来，你会怎么办？

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev3
: Cry and [masturbate], probably.
lines.zh: : 大概是哭一场然后[masturbate]吧。

lines.en: : You live an exciting life, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你的人生可真精彩，Ayane。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev4
: What can I say, Sensei? When God gives you lemons you FIND A NEW GOD.
lines.zh: : 我能说什么呢，Sensei？上帝给你柠檬，你就去找个新上帝。

lines.en: : Cool.
: Anyway, have you heard anything else about the dojo situation?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，道场那件事你还有别的消息吗？

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev5
: Huh? Why do we have to talk about depressing stuff while I look like a Christmas elf?
lines.zh: : 哈？我穿得像只圣诞小精灵的时候，为什么非得聊这么丧的事啊？

lines.en: : These are my happy clothes and we’re supposed to talk about happy things while I’m wearing them.
lines.zh: : 这身是我的开心衣服，我穿着它的时候我们就该聊开心的事。

lines.en: : I did not receive an email or notification about this.
lines.zh: : 我没收到关于这条规定的邮件或者通知。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev6
: Your notification is coming from the real me right now.
lines.zh: : 你的通知现在就是活生生的我本人发出来的。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about the dojo thingy. I talked to my dad about it and he’s going to see what he can do.
lines.zh: : 别担心道场的事啦。我跟爸爸说过了，他会去看看能怎么办。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : Did you actually talk to him or are you just saying that?
lines.zh: : 你是真的跟他谈过了，还是只是嘴上说说？

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev7
: Wanna watch Despacito on loop with me?
lines.zh: : 要跟我一起循环播放 Despacito 吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly.
lines.zh: : 不太想。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev8
Ayane ignores the fact that I do not want to watch Despacito on loop and sits down at her desk, pressing the play button on a video just seconds later.
lines.zh: Ayane 无视了我不想循环播放 Despacito 这件事，径直在书桌前坐下，几秒后就按下了视频的播放键。

lines.en: : You know, Sensei, it’s kind of rude to pry into other people’s business when it doesn’t concern you.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Sensei，跟自己无关的事还非要刨根问底，是挺失礼的。

lines.en: : I love you so I’m not mad, but you need to be careful about doing that with other people.
lines.zh: : 我爱你所以我不生气，但你跟别人相处的时候可得注意点。

lines.en: : How does the dojo thing not concern me? I’m there just as much as you are.
lines.zh: : 道场的事怎么就跟我无关了？我去得一点也不比你少。

lines.en: : I know. But what I talk about with my dad doesn’t have anything to do with you.
lines.zh: : 我知道。可我跟爸爸聊什么，跟你没关系吧。

lines.en: : That’s Ayane-speak for you haven’t been able to ask him at all, have you?
lines.zh: : 这就是 Ayane 语，翻译过来就是——你根本还没开口问过他，对吧？

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev9
: Come on...I have a hard enough time lying to you as-is.
lines.zh: : 拜托……光是瞒着你这件事本身就已经够难为我了。

lines.en: : If you know I’m not telling the truth about something, you should just let it go for my sake.
lines.zh: : 如果你明知道我在某件事上没说实话，看在我的份上就别追问了嘛。

lines.en: : I already told you there’s no way my dad would agree to something like buying an entire dojo while we already have one.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，我们已经有一间道场了，我爸不可能同意再买下一整间的。

lines.en: : And even if he tried to, we'd just be outbid by the Tsukiokas.
lines.zh: : 就算他真去试了，也会被 Tsukioka 家出价压过去。

lines.en: : Our only hope is talking that Touka girl out of her decision and I’m pretty sure no one’s ever said no to her in her life.
lines.zh: : 我们唯一的希望就是说服那个 Touka 打消念头，可我敢说，这辈子大概还没人对她说过“不”。

lines.en: : Well you’re probably right about that. I just don’t see the need for you to lie about something as simple as talking to your dad.
lines.zh: : 这点你说得大概没错。我只是不明白，跟爸爸谈个话这么简单的事，你有什么好撒谎的。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev10
: Neither do I, but I keep doing it for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我也不明白，可不知道为什么就是一直这样。

lines.en: : Do you think I’m going crazy, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是不是要疯了，Sensei？

lines.en: : You’ve been crazy since I met you.
lines.zh: : 从我认识你那天起你就疯了。

lines.en: : Good crazy, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 但是好的那种疯，对吧？

lines.en: : As long as I’m the good kind of crazy, I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 只要是好的那种疯，我就无所谓。

lines.en: : But the second I start doing things like using my wealth and influence to solve my problems instead of dealing with them the old-fashioned way, please slap me.
lines.zh: : 但只要我开始动用财富和影响力来解决问题，而不是用老老实实的办法去面对，你就扇我一巴掌。

lines.en: : Wasn’t that our exact strategy for the dojo situation?
lines.zh: : 那不正是我们处理道场这件事的策略吗？

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev11
: At first, yeah.
lines.zh: : 一开始是。

lines.en: : But there’s one thing Touka said that’s been kinda popping into my head every now and then and I think it might wind up being our ticket out of this drama.
lines.zh: : 不过 Touka 说过的一句话最近总在我脑子里冒出来，我觉得它说不定能成为我们摆脱这场闹剧的门票。

lines.en: : Remember when she mentioned that her father might be okay with {i}me{/i} training with her due to our families being kinda rich and stuff?
lines.zh: : 你还记得她说，因为{i}我{/i}们两家都挺有钱什么的，她父亲可能不介意我跟她一起训练吗？

lines.en: : Yes. And I also remember her distinctively saying I would not be welcome.
lines.zh: : 记得。我也清楚地记得她特别说了不欢迎我。

lines.en: : Right. BUT...
lines.zh: : 对。但是……

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev12
: What if we dress you up in a nice suit and slick your hair back and make you look all rich and fancy and stuff?
lines.zh: : 要是我们给你套上一身帅气西装，把头发往后梳得油光锃亮，让你看起来又阔气又体面呢？

lines.en: : Touka’s already seen the real version of me.
lines.zh: : Touka 已经见过真实的我了。

lines.en: : Oh. True.
lines.zh: : 哦。也是。

lines.en: : Well, then that just means we’ve gotta win her over by showing her you’re not the peasant she seems to think you are.
lines.zh: : 那意思就是，我们得让她看到你不是她以为的那种穷小子，这样才能把她争取过来。

lines.en: : But I {i}am{/i} the peasant she seems to think I am.
lines.zh: : 可我就{i}是{/i}她以为的那种穷小子啊。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev13
: But you’re {i}my{/i} peasant and I don’t wanna do karate stuff without you.
lines.zh: : 但你是{i}我的{/i}穷小子，我不想没有你一个人练空手道。

lines.en: : It won’t be the same getting all touchy-feely with some other girl instead of you.
lines.zh: : 换成跟别的女生搂搂抱抱，感觉完全不一样。

lines.en: : Touka’s pretty. I’m sure you’d still enjoy it.
lines.zh: : Touka 挺漂亮的。我猜你照样会很享受。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev14
: Nope. The only person who is allowed to touch me is you.
lines.zh: : 不行。唯一有资格碰我的人就是你。

lines.en: : Anyone else that tries will be getting a swift pro-wrestling style dropkick to the face. And that includes spoiled, rich girls like Touka.
lines.zh: : 其他敢试的人，脸上都会挨上一记职业摔角式的飞踢。Touka 那种被宠坏的富家女也一样。

lines.en: : What’s this? Does Ayane Amamiya finally have a real rival other than master Arakawa of the Arakawa clan?
lines.zh: : 这是怎么了？除了 Arakawa 一门的 Arakawa 师父之外，Ayane Amamiya 终于有真正的劲敌了？

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev15
: Maybe~ Do you think I should get Todd involved in {i}this{/i} battle as well?
lines.zh: : 也许吧~ 你觉得我要不要把 Todd 也拉进{i}这{/i}场战斗？

lines.en: : Only if you don’t mind having a murder charge on your hands.
lines.zh: : 只要你不在乎手上多一条谋杀罪就行。

lines.en: : At this point, I’d probably accept the risks that come with murder if it means staying together with you.
lines.zh: : 事到如今，只要能继续跟你在一起，杀人带来的风险我大概也认了。

lines.en: : Are you a yandere now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是病娇了吗？

lines.en: : Call that dojo-thief Touka pretty one more time and I will be.
lines.zh: : 你再夸那个偷道场的 Touka 漂亮一次，我就是。

lines.en: : I will be sure to not do that.
lines.zh: : 我保证不会了。

lines.en: : This is kind of weird, though. I don’t think I’ve ever heard you badmouth someone before.
lines.zh: : 不过这还挺稀奇的。我好像从没听你说过别人坏话。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev16
: I try not to.
lines.zh: : 我尽量不说。

lines.en: : And I mean, it’s not like Touka is really doing anything {i}wrong{/i}. She just...doesn’t understand other people, I guess.
lines.zh: : 而且话说回来，Touka 也没真的做{i}错{/i}什么。她只是……不太懂别人吧，我猜。

lines.en: : If you spend so much time thinking you’re better than everyone, it only makes sense to start naturally believing everybody owes you stuff.
lines.zh: : 一个人要是总觉得自己高人一等，自然而然就会开始相信所有人都欠他的。

lines.en: That’s something I disagree with entirely.
lines.zh: 这一点我完全不认同。

lines.en: I don’t think there’s any sort of justification for putting yourself on a pedestal, especially one that directly inconveniences others.
lines.zh: 我觉得把自己高高捧起、尤其是那种直接给别人添麻烦的做派，没有任何正当理由可言。

lines.en: : I, like...don’t think she’s a bad person or anything. I’m just really nervous right now.
lines.zh: : 我吧……也不是觉得她是坏人什么的。我只是现在真的很不安。

lines.en: : If we start having to hang out at my house instead, my dad or Geoffrey will wind up noticing that something’s probably going on between us.
lines.zh: : 要是以后我们只能改在我家见面，我爸或者 Geoffrey 迟早会察觉我们之间大概有点什么。

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == True:
: And you already know how I feel about risking that after the Kirin incident, so...
lines.zh: : 你也知道经过 Kirin 那件事之后，我对这种风险是什么态度，所以……

lines.en: else:
: I’m all for risky business and whatnot, but probably not {i}that{/i} risky.
lines.zh: : 冒险什么的我完全赞成，但大概不用冒{i}这么{/i}大的险。

lines.en: : I’d like to keep my family out of this for as long as possible.
lines.zh: : 我想尽可能久地把家人排除在这件事之外。

lines.en: : Or at least until we get married. After that, it’s obviously fine.
lines.zh: : 至少撑到我们结婚。在那之后当然就无所谓了。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev17
: A-Anyway, just sitting here and talking about it isn’t going to save us. We need to actually do something or we’re going to be screwed.
lines.zh: : 总、总之，光坐在这里聊是救不了我们的。我们得真的做点什么，不然就完蛋了。

lines.en: : And not the good kind of screwed that ends with our clothes on the floor. The bad kind.
lines.zh: : 而且不是最后衣服掉一地那种“完蛋”，是坏的那种。

lines.en: : Yeah. I talked to the instructor after you left last time and even {i}she{/i} had no idea what was going on.
lines.zh: : 嗯。上次你走了之后我跟教练聊过，连{i}她{/i}都不知道发生了什么。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev18
: Thinking back to what Touka said about how her dad would be hiring the best instructor in Kumon-mi means we’ll probably lose Miss Osaka too.
lines.zh: : 回想 Touka 说过她爸爸要请 Kumon-mi 最好的教练，那我们大概连 Osaka 小姐也会失去。

lines.en: : We’ll need a new dojo {i}and{/i} a new instructor.
lines.zh: : 我们会需要一间新道场，一位新教练。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’ll look Touka up on Spacebook or something and see if she’s willing to compromise there.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我去 Spacebook 什么的搜搜 Touka，看她愿不愿意在那上面各退一步。

lines.en: : Maybe she can give us like...just Saturdays to ourselves. Who knows?
lines.zh: : 也许她能给我们……比如说，只把周六留给我们。谁知道呢？

lines.en: : You’re really thinking a lot about this, huh?
lines.zh: : 你真的为这事想了很多啊。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev19
: Uh-huh.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : Things haven’t been going well for the Amamiya dynasty lately.
lines.zh: : Amamiya 王朝最近诸事不顺。

lines.en: : Damn Tsukiokas. Who would have thought the only family around with more money than mine would do something to directly inconvenience me?
lines.zh: : 该死的 Tsukioka 家。谁能想到这一带唯一比我家还有钱的家族，会做出直接给我添堵的事？

lines.en: : What kind of cliche plot development is this?
lines.zh: : 这是什么老套的剧情展开啊？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Let’s just hope it doesn’t devolve into some sort of class-warfare thing that makes you forget about my existence entirely.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。只希望它别演变成什么阶级斗争，让你把我这个人彻底忘掉。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev20
: As if I could forget about the man I admired for years and ultimately lost my virginity to.
lines.zh: : 我怎么可能忘记一个我仰慕了好多年、最后还把第一次给了他的男人。

lines.en: : Hey, crazier things have happened.
lines.zh: : 嘿，更疯狂的事都发生过。

lines.en: : That’s right. Like our first Christmas together.
lines.zh: : 没错。比如我们在一起过的第一个圣诞节。

lines.en: : Remember that?
lines.zh: : 你还记得吗？

lines.en: God damnit.
lines.zh: 该死。

lines.en: Every time Ayane brings up something from the past, I feel like I’m going to let her down by not remembering it.
lines.zh: 每次 Ayane 提起过去的事，我都怕自己因为不记得而让她失望。

lines.en: I know that so many of these memories mean the world to her and it’s incredibly irritating that the only ones I can share are the ones we've made during my time here.
lines.zh: 我知道这许许多多的回忆对她而言就是全世界，而我唯一能分享的，只有我来到这里之后我们一起创造的那些，这让我懊恼得要命。

lines.en: Don’t get me wrong, I’m all for the vast majority of these memories-
lines.zh: 别误会，这些回忆里绝大多数我都很喜欢——

lines.en: But the wholesome ones like tales of Christmas past or fried-chicken parties are things I’d love to burn into my mind as well.
lines.zh: 但像过去的圣诞节啦、炸鸡派对啦这种温馨的故事，我也想把它们烙进脑子里。

lines.en: I’m sorry, Ayane.
lines.zh: 对不起，Ayane。

lines.en: : Would you be able to remind me? My memory’s a little foggy.
lines.zh: : 你能提醒我一下吗？我记性有点模糊。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev21
: Really?! Ami and I have been so embarrassed about it all these years and you...don’t even remember?...
lines.zh: : 真的假的？！Ami 和我这些年为这事一直难为情得要死，而你……居然一点都不记得了？……

lines.en: : I’m sure I will once I hear it...
lines.zh: : 我听完应该就想起来了……

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev22
: I don’t even know how you forgot...
lines.zh: : 我真不知道你怎么会忘……

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 就是……

lines.en: : When you...found the two of us...kissing...and stuff.
lines.zh: : 就是你……撞见我们两个……在接吻……什么的。

lines.en: I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: 抱歉，什么？

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev23
: B-B-B-But...we were both really little and were just playing around!
lines.zh: : 可、可、可……可那时候我们都还很小，只是在玩而已！

lines.en: : We both wondered what it would be like to actually kiss for real and...you just happened to walk in at the {i}worst{/i} possible time.
lines.zh: : 我们俩都好奇真正的接吻是什么感觉，然后……你偏偏在{i}最糟{/i}的时机走了进来。

lines.en: Another memory I’m heartbroken to have not inherited.
lines.zh: 又一段我因为没能继承而心碎的回忆。

lines.en: This has been arguably the most devastating one so far.
lines.zh: 这大概是目前为止最让我受打击的一段。

lines.en: : Right, right.
lines.zh: : 对，对。

lines.en: : I remember now.
lines.zh: : 我想起来了。

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev24
: Y-Yeah...Hahahah...
lines.zh: : 是、是吧……哈哈哈……

lines.en: : So...that’s proof that... crazier things have definitely happened...
lines.zh: : 所以……这就证明了……更疯狂的事确实发生过……

lines.en: scene black
Ayane and I sit at her computer and she goes on to talk about more Christmas-related memories from our rather extensive past together.
lines.zh: Ayane 和我坐在她的电脑前，她接着讲起了我们那相当漫长的共同过往里，更多跟圣诞有关的回忆。

lines.en: I wish that I could have been there for them.
lines.zh: 我真希望当时我能在场。

lines.en: But, on the bright side, I’ll likely get to experience my first Christmas with her soon.
lines.zh: 但往好处想，我应该很快就能跟她一起过我们的第一个圣诞节了。

lines.en: And I’m sure that will come with several memories we’ll go on to talk about in the coming years.
lines.zh: 而且那一定会带来好几段我们在未来几年里还会反复提起的回忆。

lines.en: If I’m ever able to make it to them.
lines.zh: 如果我能活到那个时候的话。

lines.en: : Oh, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 啊，Sensei！

lines.en: : Before you go, I have a present for you.
lines.zh: : 你走之前，我有个礼物要送给你。

lines.en: : A present?
lines.zh: : 礼物？

lines.en: : What do you-
lines.zh: : 是什么——

lines.en: scene ayanewinterprev25
: Chu~
Ayane wraps her hands around my neck as I turn toward her and pulls me forward, pressing her lips against mine.
lines.zh: 我转过身去，Ayane 双手环住我的脖子，把我拉向她，将嘴唇贴了上来。

lines.en: I can feel the weight of her body pressing against me as she runs her fingers through my hair.
lines.zh: 她用手指梳理着我的头发，我能感觉到她身体的重量压在我身上。

lines.en: Our mouths do not open.
lines.zh: 我们没有张嘴。

lines.en: We do not breathe.
lines.zh: 我们没有呼吸。

lines.en: We just kiss for roughly seven seconds before splitting apart again.
lines.zh: 我们只是接了大概七秒的吻，然后分开。

lines.en: And then we say goodbye.
lines.zh: 然后我们道别。

lines.en: scene black
And then kiss three more times.
lines.zh: 然后又亲了三次。

lines.en: Ayane clearly isn’t good at letting me go.
lines.zh: Ayane 显然很不擅长放我走。

lines.en: else:
: I’ll see you in[school] tomorrow, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 明天[school]见，Sensei~

lines.en: : I’ll miss you.
lines.zh: : 我会想你的。

lines.en: : Just get some rest and I’ll talk to you then.
lines.zh: : 好好休息，到时候我再跟你聊。

lines.en: : No stalking the other rich girl on social media.
lines.zh: : 不许在社交软件上跟踪那个有钱人家的女孩。

lines.en: : You can’t buy me, hotdog man.
lines.zh: : 你买不到我的，热狗男。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Nothing.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei~

lines.en: : Right...
: Goodnight, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Ayane。
